DecisionProperties.Description: The Ministry of Economy has put forward two bold plans for mega-infrastructure projects that would help with the economic recession in the long term. Investing in projects of this scale will take up some portion of our budget but could prove worthwhile if accomplished successfully.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A decision to invest in one of two planned mega-infrastructure projects.

$items.Text: Invest in a mega-infrastructure project [-1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Invest in Mega-Infrastructure

DecisionProperties.Description: A personal investment opportunity has been relayed by Mr. Manger. An experienced stock broker in Ventrie City, Arcasia is selling valuable shares of Armadine Industries: an up and coming electronics manufacturing company. We could invest or let the opportunity pass.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: An opportunity to buy stocks from an Arcasian company.
DecisionProperties.Title: Invest in Arcasian Company Stocks

DecisionProperties.Description: With the assistance of the National Business Council and the Central Bank, Symon Holl put forward a country-wide relief plan to mitigate the economic hardships that are being felt. We can either provide stimulus cheques for people in need or bailout businesses under serious financial strain or decide not to approve the plan. [-2 Government Budget]
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: An act to ease the economic hardship felt in the country.

$items.Text: Provide stimulus cheques for people in need

DecisionProperties.Title: Economic Relief Plan

DecisionProperties.Description: The death of Bernard Circas has shocked the country and his funeral will be held in Deyr among a large crowd of sympathizers. Circas was not only a communist poet but also an elected MP that had a voice. A state funeral has been organized to honor him. The question is whether the President and the administration will attend the funeral or not.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A decision to attend the funeral of Bernard Circas.
DecisionProperties.Title: Funeral of Bernard Circas

DecisionProperties.Description: The political situation around the country has escalated. Chief Strategist Lucian Galade has prepared several action plans that we can execute. What will we do to address the intensifying political climate?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A decision to address the instability in the nation.

$items.Text: Call for restraint on national television
Expand the police by deploying all recruits in training

DecisionProperties.Title: React to the Unrest

DecisionProperties.Description: A volatile situation has emerged outside the Gasom facility, with a sizeable crowd of protestors amassing. Their grievances, fueled by underlying tensions, present a complex scenario for us to navigate. The decisions on our course of action could dramatically influence the outcome of this situation.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Decide on how to leave Gasom facility in Narbel.

$items.Text: Address the protestors and leave via car

DecisionProperties.Title: Leave Gasom Facility and Narbel

DecisionProperties.Description: An investigation on the influence of the Young Sords and Red Youth organizations on the post-assassination unrest has concluded. Neither youth group has officially organized or endorsed illegal actions, but several low- to mid-level leaders from both have links to inciting incidents that resulted in deaths, injuries and instability. This provides us with legal grounds to ban both organizations.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: An order to stop the operations of destabilizing youth organizations.

$items.Text: Ban the Red Youth and the Young Sords

DecisionProperties.Title: Stability Order of 1954

DecisionProperties.Description: The Alphonso Foundation, known for its philanthropic efforts, is launching an expansive fundraising campaign and asking for donations. The mission at its heart is two-fold: addressing the homelessness crisis and battling income inequality in our society.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The Alphonso Foundation has requested a private donation from the President.
DecisionProperties.Title: Alphonso Foundation Asks For Donation

DecisionProperties.Description:
The Gruni Rural Development Investment is a proposal by Rural Development Minister Gus Manger to bolster Sordland's rural economies and secure the nation's food sustainability. The plan envisages a judicious allocation of resources to vitalize agricultural communities, fortify food security, and elevate the regional economy of Gruni.

One potential strategy is the provision of subsidies for new farms, encouraging more players into the agricultural field. Alternatively, Manger proposes an investment in the mechanization of existing farms to improve productivity or the initiation of crop research to foster innovation.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A regional rural development proposal to improve agriculture.

$items.Text: Subsidies for new farms [-2 Government Budget]
Initiate new crop research [-1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Gruni Rural Development Investment

DecisionProperties.Description: Late in the evening, Lucian extends an invitation for a strategic game of chess within the solemn quiet of the Presidential Office.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Spend some time with Lucian to play chess or go home to rest with family.

$items.Text: Don't play and relax at home with family

DecisionProperties.Title: Lucian Offers to Play Chess

DecisionProperties.Description: Gus Manger and Symon Holl have prepared an extensive regional investment package to revitalize one of top three economically fragile regions by boosting the municipality budgets, providing large sums of business grants and giving cheap loans to companies with liquidity problems. The proposal can be implemented in one of the following regions: Bergia, Lorren and Agnland or not. [-2 Government Budget]
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A proposed regional investment to strengthen the local economies.
DecisionProperties.Title: Regional Investment Decision

DecisionProperties.Description: The recent unrest has shown weaknesses in our law enforcement's ability to maintain order and peace. The Ministry of Interior has run out of important vehicles, armor and other crowd control gear to be able to ensure stability in the country. Should we fund riot control equipment?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A proposal to procure more riot control gear to suppress the unrest.

$items.Text: Buy riot control equipment [-1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Buy Riot Control Equipment

DecisionProperties.Description: The Emergency Decree helped stabilise the country to a certain degree but the opposition is growing. The continuous usage of special powers has been opposed by Minister Morgna while Chief Justice Hawker has argued that the security situation hasn't fully resolved and is demanding an extension to fully stabilise the country. Should we extend or end the emergency?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The emergency decree could be extended or revoked.
DecisionProperties.Title: Extend Emergency Decree

DecisionProperties.Description:
Arcasian Foreign Minister Laurent Martell has proposed an extensive aid package for Sordland. This package includes financial assistance, logistical support, and equipment aid. In return, Arcasia seeks refueling and repair access at Sordland's Erlory Air Force Base, in addition to occasional flyover rights in Sordish airspace.

Arcasian President Dwight Walker has personally assured this agreement aims for peaceful objectives.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Arcasia has reached out and offered aid in return for airforce access.

$items.Text: Accept Arcasian aid and give access to base [+2 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Arcasia Offers Aid

DecisionProperties.Description:
The governments of United Contana and Arcasia have proposed a significant financial aid package for Sordland. This assistance is conditional on certain concessions pertaining to Sordland's strategic military installations. Specifically, United Contana is seeking docking privileges at the Conriat Naval Base, as well as transit rights through Sordish territorial waters for its naval vessels.

On the other hand, Arcasia is requesting landing rights at the Erlory Air Force Base. Beyond that, they are asking for permission to conduct occasional airforce rotations within Sordish airspace. This quid pro quo arrangement, while offering substantial financial benefits, would increase the military presence of both United Contana and Arcasia within Sordland, marking a significant shift in the region's geopolitical landscape.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: United Contana and Arcasia are offering aid in return for military access.

$items.Text: Accept United Contanan Aid [+3 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Superpowers Offer Aid

DecisionProperties.Description:
Foreign Secretary Atzin Nahuatl of United Contana has laid out a comprehensive aid proposal that stands to significantly improve Sordland's financial, logistical, and equipment capabilities. In exchange, United Contana seeks access to Sordland's Conriat Naval Base for refuelling and repair purposes.

Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua has personally communicated that the primary goal of this agreement is the fostering of peace and cooperation. Furthermore, the proposition includes transit rights for the United Contanan Markian Sea Fleet through Sordish waters, a detail highlighting the depth of maritime collaboration envisioned between the two nations.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: United Contana has reached out and offered aid in return for naval access.

$items.Text: Accept United Contana aid and give access to base [+3 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: United Contana Offers Aid

DecisionProperties.Description: A shocking currency crash has struck Sordland after the money supply in the country tripled due to the recent economic policies. Panic selling caused a chain reaction which led to massive currency fluctuations caused by hyperinflation. Consumer prices have quadrupled. The Central Bank of Sordland implemented emergency freezes on transactions and lowered interest rates to incentivize spending.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A massive currency crash and market rout has put us in dire straits.
DecisionProperties.Title: Black Tuesday

DecisionProperties.Description: A major naval confrontation between United Contana and Arcasia at the Gulf of Rika caused a global trade disruption. The gulf where half of the global trade flows through was blocked. Following the event Arcasia imposed considerable tariffs on CSP goods which triggered a temporary trade embargo on all Arcasian goods from the CSP. The massive financial impact was felt all around the world.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A confrontation between the superpowers is causing global economic problems.
DecisionProperties.Title: Superpower Trade War

DecisionProperties.Description: The military has voiced concerns about the cut of the military funding and requests additional funds to plug the holes in our defenses at the Rumburg border to the north. Mr. Galade advises us to accept the offer led by General Kruger. The MOD will immediately begin implementation upon approval.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Weaknesses in the frontline facing Rumburg could to be mended with new fortifications.
DecisionProperties.Title: Build Rumburg Border Fortifications

DecisionProperties.Description: Given the financial landscape revealed by the Gasom report, a strategic decision on the divestment of our shares in Gasom looms. It is now possible to consider selling an amount of our stake in the company or keep our shares for a potential future profit-share. The future outcome will vary based on the active share prices of the company.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The state can sell its shares in Gasom with varying budgetary results.

$items.Text: Keep them for potential profit share in the future

DecisionProperties.Title: Gasom State Shares Divestment

DecisionProperties.Description: The board of Gasom approved and concluded the sale of shares. The final transaction results of the divestment have arrived in this report. Minister Holl and Minister Manger have facilitated the entire process with former President Alphonso of Gasom and the returns are on their way to the state treasury.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Read the Gasom divestment financial report and see the results of sale of state shares.
DecisionProperties.Title: Gasom Shares Sale Result

DecisionProperties.Description: The SSC, Underhall Construction and Taurus Holding companies have put forward their bids in the hopes of winning the government contract for the new ambitious investment project. Which company should we pick to lead the project?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Several companies have put forward their bids for the new investment project.
DecisionProperties.Title: Award Company Contract

DecisionProperties.Description: Chief Strategist Lucian Galade has prepared a well-planned lobbying effort in the parliament which would specifically sway on the fence MP's for the upcoming constitution vote. The plan includes lavish parties, gifts and even some political favours. Should we go ahead with the plan?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The administration can start a lobbying effort to sway votes.

$items.Text: Spend money to sway MPs [-1 Personal Wealth]
Spend a generous amount of money to sway MPs [-2 Personal Wealth]
Spend vast sums of money to sway MPs [-4 Personal Wealth]

DecisionProperties.Title: Lobbying Effort in Assembly

DecisionProperties.Description: The Ministry of Economy has put forward four bold plans for investment projects with each aiming to solve different issues ranging from production to infrastructure. The four available investments are: Benfi International Airport, Morna Sea Port, Conriat Industrial Zone and Sarna Agricultural Zone. [-2 Government Budget]
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: There are several investment projects outlined which we could start.
DecisionProperties.Title: Economic Investment Project

DecisionProperties.Description:
The sudden surge in energy prices and market instability have sparked concerns among investors and analysts about the resilience of Sordland's economy. Sordland now stands at the precipice of a severe energy inflation crisis. This heightened uncertainty has led to speculative investment, a potential decrease in foreign direct investment, and the risk of a consequential economic slump. 

These developments could have a domino effect on the Sordish economy, impacting its financial markets and overall socio-economic stability.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Rapidly increasing energy prices and market volatility trigger an economic downturn.

$items.Text: Markets should regulate themselves... [-3 Government Budget]
Markets should regulate themselves... [-1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: The Sordish Energy Inflation Crisis

DecisionProperties.Description: Prominent leaders advocating for Bludish rights are seeking an audience with you, with the intention of opening a critical dialogue on their constitutional concerns.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A decision to have a meeting with prominent Bludish rights leaders about the constitution.
DecisionProperties.Title: Bludish Leaders Meeting

DecisionProperties.Description: The advocates representing the Bludish Reform Committee have arrived, carrying the revised blueprints of a reform proposal they are eager to share for the constitution.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A decision to have a meeting with the invited prominent Bludish rights leaders about the constitution.
DecisionProperties.Title: Bludish Leaders Meeting Invitation

DecisionProperties.Description: The vote of the Supreme Court draws near and we need to sway justice Heron Garaci to maximise our chances of winning the vote for the new constitution. After the initial rejection we could bribe him, send Lucian or Nia to convince him to enter the negotiation table or outright ignore the justice.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Justice Garaci has rejected our initial talks but we can try to convince him once again.
DecisionProperties.Title: Reach out to Justice Heron

DecisionProperties.Description: A whistle-blower from the Rumburg Security Bureau has escaped to Sordland by crossing the border and turned himself to the authorities in Estord. Agent Chelston Hailstone has promised to reveal extremely sensitive information about the development of a weapons program. We can give refuge to him and risk antagonising Rumburg or send him back.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A high-level agent has escaped from Rumburg and seeks refuge in Sordland.
DecisionProperties.Title: Rumburg Whistleblower Arrives

DecisionProperties.Description: Bludish NGO's and Labour Union of Sordland have co-signed a request to hold the Aschraf Anniversary remembrance in Erzaren regardless of the emergency suspension on the right to peaceful protest. We could allow this as an exception or forbid it.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A request to hold the Aschraf Anniversary remembrance has been made.
DecisionProperties.Title: Aschraf Anniversary Request

DecisionProperties.Description: The remembrance rally of the Aschraf anniversary is about to begin in Erzaren. The Bludish movement is holding their largest rally yet to display their demands and strength. Due to the activity of the BFF in the area, the security detail advises to take caution. The administration can go to Erzaren to support the event with or without an armored convoy or not attend it at all.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A question to support and attend the Aschraf Anniversary event.
DecisionProperties.Title: Support Aschraf Anniversary?

DecisionProperties.Description: In light of the recent events in the country, should the emergency be extended further to improve stability or be revoked?
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The emergency decree could be extended or revoked.
DecisionProperties.Title: Extend Emergency

DecisionProperties.Description: The highly-anticipated report from Gasom has arrived. Minister Symon Holl and Gus Manger underlines the significance of this document as it outlines the return on our state-held shares, thus, reflecting the recent performance of one of the nation's pivotal economic energy drivers. The treasury will receive a transaction if there are positive returns.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Read the Gasom annual financial report and see the results.

$items.Condition: BaseGame.Decision_Turn06_GasomStake_Keep == true && (BaseGame.Policy_Economy_EnergyProtectionAct_Removed == true && BaseGame.Turn03_EnT_Gasom_LargeSordlandInvestmentAlone == true && BaseGame.Gasom_Bankrupt == false)

DecisionProperties.Title: Gasom Financial Report

DecisionProperties.Description: There is a significant budget left in the Ministry of Health that we can spend on several different programs in order to improve healthcare in Sordland further. Funds could be used to create a medical scholarship, build a state of the art medical school, give free eye tests or dental care.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The Ministry of Health can start new programs.

$items.Text: Build state of the art medical school

DecisionProperties.Title: Healthcare Spending

DecisionProperties.Description: Minister Holl and Manger have prepared a massive industrial expansion plan that could support several key industries in the country through state investments. Sordland could become much more competitive and a hub for new industries with this initiative.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A large expansion program presents several options to improve industrial capacity.
DecisionProperties.Title: Industrial Expansion

DecisionProperties.Description: The dangerous epidemic in the Bergia region has displayed the weaknesses in our health system. As more and more patients are falling to polio it is becoming clear that without a massive batch of new iron lungs the patients will be left to die.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: More of the iron lung health equipment is needed to keep people alive from polio.

$items.Text: Buy iron lung equipment [-1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Buy Iron Lung

DecisionProperties.Description: The most influential women's rights NGO: the Sordish League of Women is organizing a massive fundraising campaign to raise awareness in Sordish society and has reached out to us personally for private donations.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The Sordish League of Women have requested a private donation from the President.

$items.Text: Donate a hefty sum [-2 Personal Wealth]

DecisionProperties.Title: Sordish League of Women Donation

DecisionProperties.Description:
Privatization fragmented the labor force into isolated, exploitative silos. Without sectoral coordination, wage stability, or collective standards, productivity has cratered. Absenteeism is rising, churn is rampant, and worker confidence is in freefall. 

Experts warn that national output will continue to decline unless corrective action restores labor cohesion or stimulates demand.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Labor market breakdown cuts national output

$items.Text: Inject direct fiscal stimulus [-2 Government Budget]
Authorize central bank to use wage liquidity tools [-1 Government Budget]
Order central bank to establish a labor coordination office [-2 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: Labor Market Collapse Drags Output

DecisionProperties.Description: A nationwide revolt erupted across the country, fueled by low public opinion and growing discontent with the government's handling of the nation. As the unrest intensified, it led to a significant decrease in stability, with violent clashes between protesters and security forces threatening to spiral into full-blown chaos.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A nationwide revolt driven by low public opinion and political discontent, severely undermines the nation's stability.
DecisionProperties.Title: The Great Dissent

DecisionProperties.Description: In an unsettling turn of events, a significant communication breakdown within the military's upper echelons and the administration has come to light. Regular reports to the Maroon Palace are not conducted adequately and sometimes there is no response at all from the generals. Fears and speculations about this have arisen.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Fears and speculations of a potential military action have begun to stir unease.
DecisionProperties.Title: Communication Breakdown with Military

DecisionProperties.Description: The United Sordland Party has recently adopted a confrontational stance, engaging in obstructionist tactics that are raising political tensions. The party's actions, primarily aimed at hindering the President's initiatives, have led to a significant slow down in policy implementation. This disruption has resulted in legislative gridlock, creating a challenging environment for the execution of administrative plans.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The USP has recently adopted a confrontational stance, engaging in obstructionist tactics that are raising tensions.
DecisionProperties.Title: USP Apparatus Obstructs

DecisionProperties.Description: A large volume scholarship program is proposed by Lucian to improve the conditions for the less fortunate students. The Rayne Scholarship will cover most if not all expenses for an estimated 50.000 students at or below the poverty line.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: A proposal for a large scholarship program is on the table.
DecisionProperties.Title: Scholarship Program Proposal

DecisionProperties.Description:
Arcasian Foreign Minister Laurent Martell, in concert with Arcasian President Dwight Walker, has extended a significant proposition to bolster Sordland's military industrial complex in Anrica.

This generous aid package from Arcasia encompasses substantial financial assistance, logistical support, and expert guidance from their Private Military Companies. This offer aligns with the industrial expansion plans outlined by Ministers Holl and Manger, aiming to transform Sordland into a competitive hub for new industries.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Arcasia has reached out and offered aid in return for airforce access.
DecisionProperties.Title: Arcasia Offers Military Investment Aid

DecisionProperties.Description:
Foreign Minister Atzin Nahuatl of United Contana, backed by Chairman Leon "Malenyev" Chavatangakwunua, has presented an expansive agricultural aid proposal to Sordland. This comprehensive package includes substantial financial investment, logistical assistance, and advanced farming equipment, in Valgen's agricultural sector.

Echoing the ambitious vision of Minister Holl and Manger, the Contanan proposal dovetails with Sordland's industrial expansion plan, signalling a new era of agricultural prosperity.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: United Contana has reached out and offered aid in return for naval access.
DecisionProperties.HubTitle: United Contana Offers Agricultural Investment Aid

$items.Text: Accept agricultural industry investment aid [+1 Government Budget]

DecisionProperties.Title: United Contana Offers Agricultural Investment Aid

DecisionProperties.Description: The Vice President position remains vacant after the events of the scandal and has to be filled by a capable person that the administration and party can trust. Several options have been laid out by the cabinet and we need to make a decision immediately.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The vacant position of Vice President is waiting to be filled.
DecisionProperties.Title: Vice President Selection

DecisionProperties.Description: As the Ministry of Economy conducted the term’s fiscal review, the latest calculations revealed a shortfall in the government's financial position. Whether due to economic shifts, policy burdens, or unforeseen expenses, the final balance has fallen below projections. The government must now determine how to address the deficit before closing the books.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Determine how to handle final budget review
DecisionProperties.Title: Fiscal Review Reveals Treasury Deficit

DecisionProperties.Description: As the Ministry of Economy conducted the term’s fiscal review, the latest calculations revealed an unexpected surplus in the government's financial position. Whether resulting from policy efficiency, increased revenues, or restrained expenditures, the final balance has exceeded initial projections. The government must now decide how best to allocate the additional funds before closing the books.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Determine how to handle final budget review
DecisionProperties.Title: Fiscal Review Reveals Treasury Surplus

DecisionProperties.Description: The election of 1957 is approaching fast and a massive election campaign effort is taking shape. The public campaign funds available to the party are covering most of the costs but we could put our own funds to increase the chances of victory. Different scale advertisement campaigns for the Rayne 1957 bid can be enacted.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The election campaign would benefit from a campaign ad boost.
DecisionProperties.Title: Rayne 57' Campaign Advertisement

DecisionProperties.Description: The possibility of funding a political youth group has arisen. We can potentially expand our ideological reach and bolster our election efforts. The Presidency would discreetly allocate substantial government funds to the youth wing, integrating them into the state as part of the essential institutions, in exchange for their loyalty and support.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The option to fund a political youth group is presented.
DecisionProperties.Title: Fund Political Youth Group

DecisionProperties.Description: Sordland faces an economic crisis due to severe capital flight, marked by the abrupt withdrawal of the Lotherberg Group and other major international investors. This outflow creates an economic vacuum, threatening job security and stability. Government efforts to maintain stability are underway, but the rapidity and scale of the capital exodus raise alarming prospects of market destabilization and potential default.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Rapid outflow of private capital and a mass withdrawal of investments exacerbate economic instability.

$items.Text: Run away to Ventie City, weaklings...

DecisionProperties.Title: The Sordish Capital Flight Crisis

DecisionProperties.Description: The mounting government budget deficit and unsustainable borrowing have led to concerns among investors and analysts about the nation's ability to service its debt. Sordland now faces a serious debt crisis. This lack of confidence has resulted in increased borrowing costs, a reduction in foreign investment, and the risk of a potential default, which could have far-reaching consequences for the Sordish economy.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Unsustainable borrowing and a ballooning budget deficit threaten to bring financial collapse.
DecisionProperties.Title: The Sordish Debt Debacle

DecisionProperties.Description: The current economic climate in Sordland has taken a severe downturn, leading to what is now being referred to as the 'Sordish Great Depression'. The sharp rise in unemployment coupled with a steep decline in Gross Domestic Product displays the gravity of the situation. Prevailing concerns about government overspending have further aggravated the crisis, giving rise to financial instability.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: The fiscal downturn has resulted in the closure of numerous businesses and the withdrawal of investors.
DecisionProperties.Title: Sordish Great Depression

DecisionProperties.Description: The former Vice President Petr Vectern has unfortunately passed away. Preparations are being made and his body is being readied for the final journey. The state can choose to honor his services to the nation with a state funeral or arrange a regular one.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Petr Vectern has passed away and we can honor him with a state funeral.
DecisionProperties.Title: Petr Vectern's Funeral

DecisionProperties.Description: The Queen of Rumburg Beatrice Livingston demands reparations to be paid by Sordland for the 15-Day War that occurred in 1870. The Foreign Ministry sees a realistic potential for a lasting peace between Sordland and Rumburg if these reparations are paid.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: Sordland can pay reparations to Rumburg to open a path to peace.
DecisionProperties.Title: Rumburg Reparations Proposal

DecisionProperties.Description: My future in Sordland is in doubt. It may be the right time to diversify my resources by keeping my money reserves safely abroad in the case of an unexpected departure.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: I could transfer my cash reserves from Sordland to Kyrute.
DecisionProperties.Title: Move Personal Wealth to Kyrute

DecisionProperties.Description: The time has come to decide on the main focus of our election campaign. Once again, we will have to determine the way forward for Sordland.
DecisionProperties.HubDescription: It is time decide on the main focus of our election campaign.
DecisionProperties.HubTitle: Main Focus of Our Election Campaign
DecisionProperties.Title: Main Focus of Our Election Campaign
